missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Боль' is a feminine -ь noun in the nominative, subject of 'не проходит'. 'Острая' is the agreeing feminine adjective describing the pain.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Боль' is the accusative direct object of 'почувствовал'; for these -ь feminines the accusative matches the nominative. 'Сильную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Боли' is the genitive of the -ь feminine after 'от', naming what the medicine is against. 'Головной' agrees in the feminine genitive.

missions.phrase: Он привык к боли в спине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Боли' is the dative after 'к', governed by 'привык', which takes that case for what one gets used to. The prepositional phrase locates the pain.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Болью' is the feminine instrumental after 'с', expressing the manner in which she endured. 'Молчаливой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О боли' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mean speaking about the pain. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Боли' is the nominative plural subject of 'стали', which agrees in the plural. The phrase 'в груди' locates the pains.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Болях' is the prepositional plural after 'о', the topic the doctor asked about. 'Моих' agrees in the plural prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Боли' is the genitive singular required by 'много'. 'У него' frames who carries it, suiting the abstract emotional sense.
Strategic focus: Genitive after без. 'Боли' is the genitive required by 'без', marking the absence of pain. The proverb-like clause makes a memorable model.
